definitions.gloss: utterance; speech; speaking (the act of producing speech)
definitions.explanation: Used in linguistics, education, and technical contexts to refer to the act or product of spoken language.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{発話|はつわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記録|きろく}する→記録する：25341_kirokusuru⟧。
{発話|はつわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{速度|そくど}→速度：03319_sokudo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{速|はや}すぎて⟦{聞|き}き{取|と}れなかった→聞き取る：04583_kikitoru⟧。
examples.english: The speech was too fast and I couldn't catch it.

examples.japanese: AI⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{音声|おんせい}{認識|にんしき}→音声認識：15961_onseininshiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{発話|はつわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦テキスト→テキスト：01469_tekisuto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変換|へんかん}する→変換する：09890_henkansuru⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧だ。
examples.english: AI speech recognition is a technology that converts speech to text.

notes:
A formal/technical term for the act of speaking or an instance of spoken language. Combines ⟦{発|はつ}→〜発：04026_hatsu⟧ (emit/produce) and {話|わ} (speech/talk). Commonly used in linguistics, language education, speech therapy, and technology contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {発話|はつわ}⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧: amount of speech output
- {発話|はつわ}⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧: speaking ability
- {発話|はつわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{分析|ぶんせき}する→分析する：25338_bunsekisuru⟧: to analyze speech
- ⟦{自発的|じはつてき}→自発的：06132_jihatsuteki⟧な{発話|はつわ}: spontaneous speech

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧: statement, remark — emphasizes the content and context of what is said, often in public settings
- ⟦{発音|はつおん}→発音：01698_hatsuon⟧: pronunciation — focuses on how sounds are produced
- ⟦{会話|かいわ}→会話：01271_kaiwa⟧: conversation — interactive exchange between speakers
